Welcome to the **Thinghood Limited** interactive studies environment. This platform hosts our core theoretical curriculums and problem sets, mapping the philosophical implications of a Monistic Universe into rigorous mathematical and categorical semantics.

---

## 🚀 Newly Added Topics

::: {.card .text-white .bg-primary .mb-4}
::: {.card-header}
**Latest Curriculum Update**
:::
::: {.card-body}
<h3 class="card-title text-white">NF Set Theory & Categorical Semantics</h3>
<p class="card-text">
A granular, 7-part exhaustive deep dive into Quine's New Foundations (NF) and Categorical Logic. This module explores the structural mechanics of a Monistic Universe (where the universal set $V$ exists), the failure of Cartesian Closedness, and the mapping of these realities to JSON ontologies using Stratified Pseudo Elephants and C-Monoids.
</p>
<a href="nf-set-theory/index.qmd" class="btn btn-light text-primary fw-bold">Start the Deep Dive ➔</a>
:::
